name: OS X.13
notes: RAM window: 0x2bc000..0x2bd000 for the RAM image. The range 0x2bd000..0x2bd100 is in use on MKII +Drive UW hardware (an image that uses it freezes at the boot logo); the emulator does not model this.

Dynamic labels: a 3,680-byte segment at 0x2be100. X.13 redirects the knob-turn stub at 0x229b38 to its add-on's value refresh (jmp $2d4b00); the engine chains through whatever that jmp names. Page-draw call sites are found by scanning the OS and the add-on for jsr/jmp $229dd2.

DSP1: X.13's add-on runs its own per-track loop and loads the DSP1 sender's address as an immediate at two sites (0x2d532c, 0x2d5402); the DSP1 transport is hooked there. Its response laws have not yet been verified by listening.

Descriptors: they are only ever read, through 13 OS and 9 add-on lea $252092 sites. Flash answers at 0x10000000 after OS_MAIN's init, so descriptors can live in flash. The misaligned long read from flash at offset +$32 is not yet covered by a hardware test.
DSP2: X.13's add-on copies its own DSP2 code to P:0x13b600..0x13c107 at boot (routine 0x2c039e), so the patcher's DSP2 regions start at 0x13c108.
